messages:
Alex: Quick standup — US-west rotation done, prewarm pools scaled down then back up to clear stuck jobs. 8 GPUs reprovisioned (p4d).
Alex: Blockers: APAC spot evictions spiking last 45m, queue thrash + autoscaler flapping. Seeing ~12% higher pending queue for embeddings.
Marie: Can you paste the monitor query? curious about node churn. Also did you open a ticket with the cloud vendor?
Alex: Query I used: `sum by(zone) (increase(spot_evictions_total[1h]))` -> result: `us-west1:3, apac1:9, eu-west1:0`.
Alex: Filed INF ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 — vendor looking into host reclaim patterns.
OpsBot: :warning: [ALERT] GPU_SPOT_EVICTIONS_RATE fired x3 in last hour — https://alerts.internal/12345
Sanjay Patel: Short-term mitigation: lock 2-4 critical worker pools to on-demand in APAC for the next 24-48h? We have 4 spare d3s in reserved pool we can borrow.
Marie: If we go on-demand that's a cost hit. Alternative: increase KV cache TTL so we avoid repeated cold-starts and reduce churn on nodes.
Alex: Did the TTL bump — changed `redwood.cache.kv_ttl` from 30 -> 90 seconds in staging config. Rolling to prod now, will monitor cache hit ratio.
Taylor: I opened PR #789 to add autoscaler hysteresis (30s cooldown + ignore transient evictions). @Alex @Sanjay can you review? small change in controllers/autoscaler.go
Alex: Reviewing PR now. Quick perf note: with current prewarm policy throughput nominal ~1.2k tok/s per p4d, but variance increases during evictions — hysteresis should reduce flapping.
Marie: Headroom ask: if APAC keeps evicting we should precommit 2 more Dedicated nodes for weekend traffic. Ops/finance: can we get ballpark cost?
Sanjay Patel: Rough back-of-envelope: 2 p4d reserved ~ $18k/mo. I'll run exact pricing by EOD and post numbers.
Taylor: Also scheduled rolling restart for canary model v2 at 03:00 UTC to validate autoscaler hysteresis in a controlled window.
Alex: Sounds good. Would like someone to watch the dashboards during the window and ack if metrics look healthy — @Marie can you take that?
Marie: Happy to monitor the dashboard 02:50–04:00 UTC and post a short status in this thread.
Taylor: PR updated with unit + integration test, added note about cooldown param in README. Tagging reviewers: @Alex @Marie
Alex: LGTM on tests, left two tiny nits inline. Will merge after CI green.
OpsBot: Deploy job started: deploy/rollout-v2 (canary) — logs: https://ci.internal/564 — status: queued -> running
Marie: Thanks everyone. Post-merge check: if eviction rate drops below threshold for 1h, we can revert TTL tweak to 60s and keep autoscaler cooldown in place. If not, proceed with on-demand fallback.
Alex: Agreed. I'll update INF-4321 with outcomes and next steps.
Sanjay Patel: I'll prepare the cost breakdown and a short runbook for switching to reserved nodes if vendor ETA slips.
Taylor: If anyone needs quick context, I added a short diagram to the PR describing decision flow: `eviction -> hysteresis -> TTL bump -> on-demand fallback`.
Alex: Great. Closing loop: no blocking code reviews left, TTL rollout in progress, ticket filed, canary scheduled. Will post metrics in ~30m.
